# Report Structure & GxP Rationale

Each section maps to a regulatory requirement.

## Section 1: Event Description
**Source:** LIMS JSON fields
**Requirement:** 21 CFR 211.192 — all unexplained discrepancies must be recorded

## Section 2: Phase I — Laboratory Investigation
**Generated by:** LLM with RAG context
**Requirement:** FDA OOS Guidance (2006), Section III.A
Covers: analyst technique, instrument calibration, system suitability,
sample integrity, calculation verification.

## Section 3: Phase II — Manufacturing Investigation
**Generated by:** LLM with RAG context
**Requirement:** FDA OOS Guidance (2006), Section III.B
Only initiated when Phase I finds no assignable lab error.

## Section 4: CAPA
**Generated by:** LLM
**Requirement:** ICH Q10 Section 3.2 — CAPA system

## Section 5: Conclusion & Batch Disposition
**Generated by:** LLM
**Requirement:** 21 CFR 211.192 — investigation conclusion must support disposition

## Section 6: Approvals
**Static template**
**Requirement:** 21 CFR Part 11 — electronic records need human sign-off
QC and QA signatures required before use.

## Audit Trail (.audit.json)
Auto-generated alongside every .docx.
Records: model version, temperature, retrieved passages + scores, timestamps.
